import re

def get_text(i): return ''.join(x.get('text','') for x in objs[i]['message'].get('content',[]) if isinstance(x,dict))
for idx in [7,9]:
    tx=get_text(idx)
    print('\nMSG',idx,tx[:80])
    # Find input and output sections rows
    parts=tx.split('Demo pair')
    # build matrices from exact labels
    m=re.search(r'input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output',tx,re.S)
    if m:
        H,W=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2)); inp=[[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in m.group(3).splitlines()]
        n=re.search(r'output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance|\Z)',tx,re.S)
        out=[[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in n.group(1).splitlines() if ln.strip()]
        print(H,W,len(inp),len(out),[len(r) for r in inp][:2],[len(r) for r in out][:2])
        print('diffs:',[(r,c,inp[r][c],out[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]!=out[r][c]])
